solution: A solution to an equation is a value of a variable that makes the equation true.
To find the solution, substitute each value of x into the equation: $$x+18=32$$
Substitute the value $$x=14$$ into the equation. $$x+18=32$$ $$14+18=32$$ $$32=32$$
The value $$x=14$$ makes this equation true. So, $$x=14$$ is the solution.
Substitute the value $$x=13$$ into the equation. $$x+18=32$$ $$13+18=31$$ $$31$$ is not equal to $$32$$
The value $$x=13$$ makes this equation false. So, $$x=13$$ is not a solution.
